name: Camping Insel Buchau am Staffelsee
beschreibung: The campsite Insel Buchau am Staffelsee is located in the federal state of Tirol. It offers pitches for caravans, motorhomes and tents. The facility has modern sanitary facilities and electricity connections. A restaurant and a small shop are available on site. The surrounding area invites you to go on hikes and cycling tours. The lake that gives it its name enables swimming trips and water sports. The campsite is a suitable starting point for excursions into the mountains of Tirol.
